title: CrewAI autolog leaked LLM api_key into span attributes and inputs via Agent, Crew, Task and LLM objects
answers: Why does my API key show up in the MLflow trace when I use CrewAI autologging?
CrewAI LLM api_key visible in span attributes or span inputs
mlflow.crewai.autolog leaks provider credentials into trace telemetry
body:
Symptom: a user passing LLM(api_key=...) to a CrewAI Agent or Crew sees the provider key in MLflow trace attributes or span inputs after mlflow.crewai.autolog().
Root cause: mlflow/crewai/autolog.py:_get_agent_attributes stringified agent.llm (str() of a pydantic model includes api_key); mlflow/crewai/autolog.py:_construct_full_inputs expanded each argument's __dict__, carrying nested Agent/LLM objects; mlflow/crewai/autolog.py:_set_span_attributes passed manager_llm, planning_llm and chat_llm raw to the JSON encoder.
Fix pattern: sanitize before stringifying or serializing. mlflow/crewai/autolog.py:_sanitize_value recursively reduces a crewai BaseLLM to its model name, walks other pydantic models field by field with a cycle guard, and drops credential-named dict keys.
Constraints: applies to any CrewAI object placed on a span (attributes or inputs). Outputs in patched_class_call and patched_standalone_call use _sanitize_value too, but the PR notes no CrewAI result type carries an LLM object.
applies: Any change in mlflow/crewai/autolog.py that puts CrewAI objects (Agent, Crew, Task, LLM, executors) onto spans or span inputs.
says: Secret API keys are visible in plain text inside agent execution trace spans.
Autologging exposes language model credentials in trace attributes and inputs.
Hide confidential API tokens from automated traces when logging multi-agent runs.
Provider secret keys are leaking into trace telemetry during agent task execution.
Mask model credentials so private access keys do not appear in trace details.
search: mlflow.crewai.autolog sanitizes CrewAI objects before placing them onto trace span attributes or inputs to avoid leaking provider credentials. In mlflow/crewai/autolog.py, _sanitize_value recursively reduces BaseLLM instances to model names, walks Pydantic models field by field with cycle protection, and drops credential-named dictionary keys. This replaces raw serialization in _get_agent_attributes, _construct_full_inputs, and _set_span_attributes where agent.llm, manager_llm, planning_llm, and chat_llm previously exposed api_key. The rule applies to any CrewAI object attached to span attributes or inputs, including outputs handled in patched_class_call and patched_standalone_call.
